auggie.name: August Pullman
auggie.role: protagonist — 10-year-old boy with a craniofacial condition, starting fifth grade at Beecher Prep for the first time

via.name: Via Pullman
via.role: Auggie's older sister — a high-school freshman who has spent years being invisible in her brother's shadow

jack.name: Jack Will
jack.role: Auggie's first real friend — initially recruited by Tushman, he genuinely chooses Auggie's side after the Halloween betrayal

summer.name: Summer Dawson
summer.role: girl who sits with Auggie on the first day out of genuine kindness — not pity, not a dare

julian.name: Julian Albans
julian.role: the bully — popular, handsome, runs a whisper campaign against Auggie that stays just under adult radar

charlotte.name: Charlotte
charlotte.role: the neutral — knows what is wrong but protects her own social standing instead of acting

tushman.name: Mr. Tushman
tushman.role: middle school principal — well-meaning architect of Auggie's welcome, installs 'moral training wheels' by choosing Auggie's first friends

isabel.name: Isabel Pullman
isabel.role: Auggie's mother — former children's book illustrator, devoted but also complicit in her son's over-protection
